description: The multi-agent starters (flisk project swarm, flisk project security, flisk project super-agent, flisk project langgraph, flisk project tool-loop) through a real flisk up as local processes, no Docker. Chaos cases kill -9 a worker holding a claim and the coordinator mid-goal: the flisk up supervisor must start them again and the swarm must still finish the goal, with the killed worker's subtask retried. The super-agent cases kill -9 its MCP tool server and its planner mid-run: retries back off until the tool server is back, and the planner's saved goals survive its restart. The LangGraph cases kill -9 the agent between graph nodes (it must resume from its checkpoint without rerunning a finished node) and the tool server (LangGraph's retry policy must outlast the restart). The tool-loop cases run the Anthropic SDK's real tool runner against a local mock model, and kill -9 the model and the tool server before a question: the SDK's and the agent's retries must outlast each restart.
